# Gray Tile & Remodeling

> Tile contractor and home remodeler in Bowdon, Georgia, serving Carroll County and West Georgia.

## Business Information

**Business:** Gray Tile & Remodeling
**Category:** Tile contractor (Google Business Profile)
**Location:** Bowdon, GA 30108 (service-area business)
**Phone:** (404) 310-3381
**Email:** graytile@bellsouth.net
**Hours:** Mon–Thu 9am–5pm
**Website:** https://graytileremodeling.com/

## What the company does

Gray Tile & Remodeling installs custom tile showers, kitchen and bathroom remodels, flooring (tile, LVP, hardwood refinishing) and finished basements, and handles additions and structural work in-house. Estimates are free.
